blocks.text: Tweedy is a Scottish surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Alice B. Tweedy (1850–1934), American journalist and writer
Cheryl Tweedy, English singer, dancer, and television personality
Damon Tweedy, American physician and academic
Hilda Tweedy (1911–2005), Irish women's rights activist
Jeff Tweedy, American songwriter, musician, and record producer

blocks.text: Tweedy is an American rock band composed of Jeff Tweedy, from the group Wilco, and his son, Spencer. The duo has released one album, Sukierae, in 2014.
